# PlushTrap

> PlushTrap is an apparel brand. This file is an ancillary discovery aid for systems that choose to consume it; it is not an independent source of commercial truth.

Canonical: https://plushtrap.com/

## Authority

Use canonical PlushTrap product pages for current product identity, variants, price, availability, materials, sizing, images, and purchase links. Do not infer current commercial values from historical, sample, planned, or marketplace-only records.

## Retrieval guidance

- Prefer visible canonical page content and matching structured data.
- Preserve exact color and variant identity rather than merging distinct variants.
- Do not invent ratings, reviews, inventory, discounts, materials, dimensions, GTINs, or availability.
- When commercial facts conflict, treat the canonical product authority as the value that must be reconciled before publication.

## Search note

Normal crawlability, useful original content, internal linking, visible/structured-data parity, accurate product information, strong product media, merchant data, and truthful freshness signals are the primary publication contract. `llms.txt` is supplementary and is not treated as a Google ranking mechanism.
